rationale: The workflow already implements the dependency-caching optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) via Swatinem/rust-cache across all major Rust build and test jobs (linux-build-lib, linux-test, linux-test-datafusion-cli, linux-test-example, clippy, and the feature-check jobs), with Cargo.lock as a cache input. The pattern's contraindication 'An equivalent cache already exists' therefore applies. Concurrency cancellation of superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is already configured via concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true. No matrix jobs exist for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, there are no scheduled workflows for schedule-related patterns, and adding custom timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) is unsupported without representative runtime history and risks breaking valid slow runs. No suitable, evidence-supported change remains that preserves coverage without unrelated modifications.
